verdict.rationale: Reclaim documents out-of-office handling: a help article explains telling Reclaim about vacation or OOO time, including whether Tasks and Habits keep scheduling, and it markets automatic OOO visibility. Hashtags like #reclaim_free (no-meeting days) and #reclaim_busy act as per-day or per-event availability overrides, and scheduling links share your availability. However, nothing in the pack documents configuring working hours or a structured availability schedule. missing for 10: documented working-hours configuration, a structured date-override mechanism beyond event hashtags, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
